endorsements.name: Thomas Bouzerar
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Vancouver 2023 - Day Two Results
endorsements.description: Thomas Imbert ( @masthoon ) and Thomas Bouzerar ( @MajorTomSec ) from Synacktiv ( @Synacktiv ) demonstrated a 3-bug chain against Oracle VirtualBox with a Host EoP. One bug was previously known. They still earn $80,000 and 8 Master of Pwn points.
endorsements.subtitle: Pwn2Own 2023
